script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

A modern office space, filled with employees working intently on their computers. Our protagonist, JAMES, sits at his desk, looking stressed and overworked.

JAMES: (sighs) Another long day.

Suddenly, an EMAIL NOTIFICATION chimes on his computer.

JAMES: (typing) Open email...

INT. EMAIL INBOX - CLOSE UP

James opens an email from HR, titled "New Project Announcement."

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

James reads the email aloud to his colleagues.

JAMES: (excited) Look at this! We've been selected to work on a new project. It's a top-secret AI development.

COWORKER 1: (skeptical) AI, again?

JAMES: (defensive) Yes, but this one is different. It's a human-robot collaboration.

COWORKER 2: (smiling) Oh, I've heard that one before.

James rolls his eyes and continues working.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - LAB - NIGHT

James and his team work tirelessly to develop the new AI system. They encounter many challenges and setbacks, but they persevere.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

James and his team present their progress to the CEO and the board of directors. They are met with criticism and skepticism.

CEO: (displeased) This is not what I expected. We need results, not promises.

JAMES: (determined) We'll make it work. We believe in this project.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - LAB - NIGHT

James and his team work late into the night, determined to prove themselves.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

The next day, they receive a surprise visit from the CEO.

CEO: (impressed) I see progress. Keep going.

James and his team cheer in relief and continue their work.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

Weeks later, they finally complete the AI system. They present it to the CEO and the board of directors.

CEO: (smiling) This is impressive. We have a working prototype.

JAMES: (proud) We did it.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - LAB - NIGHT

James and his team celebrate their success, exhausted but happy.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - DAY

The next morning, they receive an email from a major client, expressing interest in their AI system.

INT. TECHNOLOGY COMPANY - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

James and his team prepare for their first meeting with the client. They are nervous but excited.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
